features.text: Dual-pull tension system delivers customizable lumbar compression and support
Reinforced support panels maintain optimal spinal alignment during daily activities
Moisture-wicking, breathable materials ensure comfortable extended wear
Easy-grip side pulls allow quick compression adjustments throughout the day
Low-profile design works seamlessly under clothing for discreet support

measurement: To ensure optimal lumbar support, measure your waist circumference at the navel using a soft measuring tape. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing instructions and our guarantee of finding your perfect fit.
